## Type

Select one (conventional commit prefix):

- [ ] `feat:` — new feature
- [ ] `fix:` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor:` — code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] `docs:` — documentation only
- [ ] `ci:` — continuous integration / build / deployment
- [ ] `chore:` — maintenance, tooling, or other non-code change

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for behavioral changes
- [ ] No new dependencies without explicit justification
- [ ] Conventional commit used (`feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, `docs:`, `ci:`, `chore:`)
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated if this change is user-facing
- [ ] No secrets, keys, credentials, or tokens committed
